verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a proprietary product-data API. The evidence shows Channel3 adopting other parties' protocols (MCP clients like Cursor and Claude, UCP-capable agents, MPP payments) and developers consuming its API, but no independent party implementing Channel3's own protocol or platform. Supporting third-party standards and having API customers is adjacent to the story, not evidence of a multi-implementer ecosystem.

support.subject: As a developer, at least two independent parties beyond the vendor implement the protocol or platform — it is an ecosystem, not a private integration
